holds the full context · steers, never speaks" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="110" width="380" x="40" y="310" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="harness" parent="engine" style="swimlane;rounded=1;arcSize=4;startSize=54;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;strokeWidth=2;fontSize=15;fontStyle=1;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;pointerEvents=0;" value="Harness Context
(context manager)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="370" width="540" x="600" y="60" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="ctx1" parent="harness" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=13;align=left;spacingLeft=14;" value="Candidate Persona" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="60" width="480" x="30" y="70" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="ctx2" parent="harness" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=13;align=left;spacingLeft=14;" value="Interview Details (candidate perspective)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="60" width="480" x="30" y="145" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="ctx3" parent="harness" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#fff2cc;strokeColor=#d6b656;strokeWidth=2;fontSize=13;align=left;spacingLeft=14;" value="Turns and Rounds (transcripts)
<i>both live streams land here</i>" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="60" width="480" x="30" y="220" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="ctx4" parent="harness" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=13;align=left;spacingLeft=14;" value="Candidate info (name, gender)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="60" width="480" x="30" y="295" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e_audio_out" edge="1" parent="1" source="speaker" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;orthogonalLoop=1;jettySize=auto;html=1;strokeColor=#6c8ebf;strokeWidth=2;fontSize=12;fontColor=#40597a;labelBackgroundColor=#ffffff;verticalAlign=bottom;exitX=0;exitY=0.2;exitDx=0;exitDy=0;entryX=1;entryY=0.32;entryDx=0;entryDy=0;" target="user" value="persona audio out"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e_audio_in" edge="1" parent="1" source="user" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;orthogonalLoop=1;jettySize=auto;html=1;strokeColor=#6c8ebf;strokeWidth=2;fontSize=12;fontColor=#40597a;labelBackgroundColor=#ffffff;verticalAlign=top;exitX=1;exitY=0.9;exitDx=0;exitDy=0;entryX=0;entryY=0.727;entryDx=0;entryDy=0;" target="speaker" value="interviewer audio in"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e_tx_user" edge="1" parent="1" source="user" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;orthogonalLoop=1;jettySize=auto;html=1;dashed=1;strokeColor=#9673a6;strokeWidth=2;fontSize=12;fontColor=#6b4f80;labelBackgroundColor=#ffffff;exitX=0;exitY=0.75;exitDx=0;exitDy=0;entryX=0;entryY=0.5;entryDx=0;entryDy=0;" target="thinker" value="<b>input transcription</b> (user side)
interviewer's speech, live fragments
while they are still talking"> <mxGeometry relative="1" x="0.2" as="geometry"> <mxPoint y="-26" as="offset" /> <Array as="points"> <mxPoint x="30" y="285" /> <mxPoint x="30" y="505" /> </Array> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e_tx_persona" edge="1" parent="1" source="speaker" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;orthogonalLoop=1;jettySize=auto;html=1;dashed=1;strokeColor=#9673a6;strokeWidth=2;fontSize=12;fontColor=#6b4f80;labelBackgroundColor=#ffffff;exitX=0.2;exitY=1;exitDx=0;exitDy=0;entryX=0.2;entryY=0;entryDx=0;entryDy=0;" target="thinker" value="<b>output transcription</b>
(persona side) — what the
Speaker actually spoke, live"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <mxPoint y="-14" as="offset" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e_direction" edge="1" parent="1" source="thinker" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;orthogonalLoop=1;jettySize=auto;html=1;strokeColor=#b85450;strokeWidth=3;fontSize=12;fontStyle=1;fontColor=#8a3b38;labelBackgroundColor=#ffffff;exitX=0.75;exitY=0;exitDx=0;exitDy=0;entryX=0.75;entryY=1;entryDx=0;entryDy=0;" target="speaker" value="direction
soft · instant ·
non-interrupting"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <mxPoint y="14" as="offset" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e_ctx_speaker" edge="1" parent="1" source="harness" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;orthogonalLoop=1;jettySize=auto;html=1;strokeColor=#82b366;strokeWidth=2;fontSize=12;fontColor=#4e6b3d;labelBackgroundColor=#ffffff;exitX=0;exitY=0.2;exitDx=0;exitDy=0;entryX=1;entryY=0.49;entryDx=0;entryDy=0;" target="speaker" value="small context
(speaking only)"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e_ctx_thinker" edge="1" parent="1" source="harness" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;orthogonalLoop=1;jettySize=auto;html=1;strokeColor=#82b366;strokeWidth=2;fontSize=12;fontColor=#4e6b3d;labelBackgroundColor=#ffffff;exitX=0;exitY=0.8;exitDx=0;exitDy=0;entryX=1;entryY=0.42;entryDx=0;entryDy=0;" target="thinker" value="full context
persona · details
· transcript"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e_store" edge="1" parent="1" source="thinker" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;orthogonalLoop=1;jettySize=auto;html=1;dashed=1;strokeColor=#9673a6;strokeWidth=2;fontSize=12;fontColor=#6b4f80;labelBackgroundColor=#ffffff;exitX=0.5;exitY=1;exitDx=0;exitDy=0;entryX=0.5;entryY=1;entryDx=0;entryDy=0;" target="harness" value="writes both live streams into <b>Turns and Rounds</b>"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <Array as="points"> <mxPoint x="610" y="590" /> <mxPoint x="1250" y="590" /> </Array> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="panel" parent="1" style="swimlane;rounded=1;arcSize=3;startSize=48;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;fillColor=none;swimlaneFillColor=none;strokeColor=#333333;strokeWidth=2;fontSize=16;fontStyle=1;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;pointerEvents=0;" value="When the Reasoning model (Thinker) sends its direction — two windows, one forbidden case" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="470" width="1520" x="60" y="670" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="winA" parent="panel" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;strokeWidth=2;fontSize=12;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacingLeft=14;spacingRight=14;spacingTop=8;" value="<b>Window A — before speaking</b><br><i>the primary path</i><br><br>1. The interviewer's turn ends — the engine closes the activity window.<br><br>2. The Thinker, which has been reading the live transcript the whole time the interviewer talked, injects its direction as a <b>short plain context note</b>.<br><br>3. Only then does the Speaker answer. The note is never spoken — it steers the reply." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="210" width="450" x="30" y="70" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="winB" parent="panel" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#dae8fc;strokeColor=#6c8ebf;strokeWidth=2;fontSize=12;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacingLeft=14;spacingRight=14;spacingTop=8;" value="<b>Window B — once it stops speaking</b><br><i>the catch-up path</i><br><br>1. The Speaker finishes its turn (<i>turnComplete</i>).<br><br>2. The Thinker updates the context — what was actually said, and the claims made.<br><br>3. It queues direction for the <b>next</b> turn, so Window A already has it ready." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="210" width="450" x="535" y="70" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="winC" parent="panel" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f8cecc;strokeColor=#b85450;strokeWidth=2;fontSize=12;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacingLeft=14;spacingRight=14;spacingTop=8;dashed=1;" value="<b>Never — mid-sentence</b><br><i>the forbidden case</i><br><br>No direction is injected while the Speaker is talking: that is exactly what makes the speaking model <b>blunder or interrupt</b>.<br><br>If a correction is truly urgent the engine's only tool is to <b>cancel the response and re-answer</b> — the exception, not the flow." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="210" width="450" x="1040" y="70" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="latency" parent="panel" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffe6cc;strokeColor=#d79b00;strokeWidth=2;fontSize=12;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacingLeft=16;spacingRight=16;spacingTop=8;" value="<b>Latency rule — rides on Window A.</b>&nbsp; The direction target is <b>milliseconds</b>; the recall phrase is the cover for the rare miss, <b>not the normal path</b>.<br><br><b>We don't want latency.</b> If the Thinker is not ready the instant the interviewer stops, the Speaker does what a real human does when recalling — <b>buys time in character</b> with a natural phrase (“let me think…”, “hmm, good question”, “so, when I was at…”) — and the direction lands <b>under that phrase</b>.<br><br><b>Never</b> a bare pause, <b>never</b> a robotic gap, <b>never</b> a canned filler that sounds like a system stalling." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="112" width="1460" x="30" y="302" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e_a_lat" edge="1" parent="panel" source="winA" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;orthogonalLoop=1;jettySize=auto;html=1;dashed=1;strokeColor=#d79b00;strokeWidth=2;endArrow=none;exitX=0.25;exitY=1;exitDx=0;exitDy=0;entryX=0.15;entryY=0;entryDx=0;entryDy=0;" target="latency" value=""> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="panelcap" parent="panel" style="text;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;fontSize=13;fontColor=#555555;" value="Both windows are silences: the direction lands <b>softly, instantly</b> and <b>without breaking speech</b>." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="30" width="1460" x="30" y="424" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e_ab" edge="1" parent="panel" source="winA" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;orthogonalLoop=1;jettySize=auto;html=1;strokeColor=#666666;strokeWidth=2;fontSize=11;fontColor=#555555;labelBackgroundColor=#ffffff;exitX=1;exitY=0.5;exitDx=0;exitDy=0;entryX=0;entryY=0.5;entryDx=0;entryDy=0;" target="winB" value="then"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="notes" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#fff2cc;strokeColor=#d6b656;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacingLeft=16;spacingTop=10;spacingRight=16;fontSize=13;" value="<b>Notes (from the sketch)</b><br><br>• The Reasoning model gets the realtime transcript from <b>both ends</b> — <b>input transcription</b> of the interviewer's speech and <b>output transcription</b> of what the Speaker actually spoke, both arriving live rather than after the turn — and stores them in the Harness Context under Turns and Rounds.<br><br>• Without breaking speech, and without making the speaking model blunder or interrupt, it <b>softly and instantly</b> tells the speech model what to say or speak.<br><br>• Engine naming: the speech model is the <b>Speaker</b>, the reasoning model is the <b>Thinker</b> — one brain, two parts (see okf/concepts/subsystems/engine.md)." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="170" width="1520" x="60" y="1170" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>

div.div: When the Reasoning model (Thinker) sends its direction — two windows, one forbidden case

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(213, 232, 212), rgb(31, 47, 30)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(130, 179, 102), rgb(68, 110, 44));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 420px; height: 1px; padding-top: 715px; margin-left: 84px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 12px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#000000, #ffffff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
Window A — before speaking
the primary path
1. The interviewer's turn ends — the engine closes the activity window.
2. The Thinker, which has been reading the live transcript the whole time the interviewer talked, injects its direction as a short plain context note.
3. Only then does the Speaker answer. The note is never spoken — it steers the reply.

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(218, 232, 252), rgb(29, 41, 59)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(108, 142, 191), rgb(92, 121, 163));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 420px; height: 1px; padding-top: 715px; margin-left: 589px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 12px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#000000, #ffffff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
Window B — once it stops speaking
the catch-up path
1. The Speaker finishes its turn (turnComplete).
2. The Thinker updates the context — what was actually said, and the claims made.
3. It queues direction for the next turn, so Window A already has it ready.

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(248, 206, 204), rgb(81, 45, 43)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(184, 84, 80), rgb(215, 129, 126));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 420px; height: 1px; padding-top: 715px; margin-left: 1094px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 12px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#000000, #ffffff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
Never — mid-sentence
the forbidden case
No direction is injected while the Speaker is talking: that is exactly what makes the speaking model blunder or interrupt.
If a correction is truly urgent the engine's only tool is to cancel the response and re-answer — the exception, not the flow.

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 230, 204), rgb(54, 33, 10)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(215, 155, 0), rgb(153, 101, 0));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 1426px; height: 1px; padding-top: 947px; margin-left: 86px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 12px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#000000, #ffffff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
Latency rule — rides on Window A. The direction target is milliseconds; the recall phrase is the cover for the rare miss, not the normal path.
We don't want latency. If the Thinker is not ready the instant the interviewer stops, the Speaker does what a real human does when recalling — buys time in character with a natural phrase (“let me think…”, “hmm, good question”, “so, when I was at…”) — and the direction lands under that phrase.
Never a bare pause, never a robotic gap, never a canned filler that sounds like a system stalling.

div.div:
Notes (from the sketch)
• The Reasoning model gets the realtime transcript from both ends — input transcription of the interviewer's speech and output transcription of what the Speaker actually spoke, both arriving live rather than after the turn — and stores them in the Harness Context under Turns and Rounds.
• Without breaking speech, and without making the speaking model blunder or interrupt, it softly and instantly tells the speech model what to say or speak.
• Engine naming: the speech model is the Speaker, the reasoning model is the Thinker — one brain, two parts (see okf/concepts/subsystems/engine.md).
